The LM1117MPX-5.0 (part number IC-1007) cannot replace the NCP1117ST50T3G (part number IC-1003) on the UNO board assembly (ASM-11000) because it fails the specification check. Specifically, the LM1117MPX-5.0 has a lower voltage rating (5 V) compared to the NCP1117ST50T3G, which has a voltage rating of 20 V or higher. This discrepancy means that the LM1117MPX-5.0 may not meet the voltage requirements of the UNO board.

Here is a summary of the results:

| Part Number | Description                | Usable Substitute? |
|-------------|----------------------------|--------------------|
| IC-1003     | NCP1117ST50T3G             | No                 |
| IC-1007     | LM1117MPX-5.0              | No                 |

Basis:
- The substitution check was performed using the `alternates` tool on the UNO board assembly (ASM-11000) on the production date 2027-03-01.
- The tool returned that the LM1117MPX-5.0 (IC-1007) is not a usable substitute due to a specification check failure (voltage rating).

This information is based on the rules applied, the production date, and the scope of the UNO board assembly.
